content.title: Arvada Ridge Station
content.summary: Arvada Ridge Station is conveniently located near Red Rocks Community College and features pedestrian and cyclist access via a new underpass at Kipling Parkway. The area will soon include a new park with inclined trails, and public art titled \"Chromatic Harvest,\" created by artists Shane Allbritton and Norman Lee, reflects Arvada's agricultural heritage through contemporary design on ceramic steel panels.
content.body:
The Arvada Ridge Station is an easy walk to Red Rocks Community College. The Station is easy to access for pedestrians and cyclists thanks to a new underpass at Kipling Parkway. The nearby area features single and multi-family housing. A new park, coming soon, will feature inclined trails and more.

## Public Art at the Station

The art selected for Arvada Ridge is titled "Chromatic Harvest" and takes its inspiration by connecting the past with the present and the future using the themes of agriculture and movement. Geometric crop rows are reinterpreted in a contemporary way on ceramic steel panels, connecting Arvada's agricultural past with its dynamic present.

![Arvada Ridge Station Art](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=530 "Arvada Ridge Station Art")

## Artist Details

The artists behind “Chromatic Harvest” are Shane Allbritton and Norman Lee. The two founded [RE:site](http://www.resite-studio.com/). To learn more about the artists, please visit their profile on [RTD-FasTracks.com](http://www.rtd-fastracks.com/main_475).
